Dralin Uveran: Dralin Uveran, a step from the hold's door as the player comes out. Tells: he is Dralin Uveran, gang-master here. The player's name is not on his roll: he struck it this morning, before they cut a single reed, on an order brought down the road by Vosh-Leera, the root-herald of Jal-Veesa, the one who speaks for that town's elders and its tree to outsiders. He cannot refuse a root-herald. "You must have friends in high places." He paid for the player's months and has lost them. Vosh-Leera left word: she will have work for the player if they bring her some Sithis' beard, a grey moss that hangs on the woven weir at Reed-Sill Weir, the weir-wardens' camp where the road east meets the creek; her house is in Jal-Veesa, a little further on past the weir. What she wants with either of them he does not know and does not care to. Mind the crocodiles under the weir. Then: the player will need to look after themselves on the road. He has not got much to spare, but he can offer one of these, Naga make (the deep-swamp tribes set flint in wood) left behind by dead cutters when the fever took them: a Naga warhammer, flint set in a wooden head; a Naga sword, a wooden blade edged with flint; a bamboo bow with twenty flint-tipped arrows and a flint knife; or a spell tome of Sparks that one of them carried up from Stormhold, which teaches a lightning spell. Take your pick. Does: sets stage 50. Checks: nothing.
